svg.title: On-chain: how an RGB payment travels on Bitcoin
svg.text: On-chain: how an RGB payment travels on Bitcoin

g.text: The supplier creates the RGB invoice
It holds a blinded UTXO (utxob), the expiry (mandatory in rgb-lib) and the proxy endpoint. It arrives as text or a QR
rgb-lib asks Esplora for colored UTXOs, the TUSDT balance and the state of transfers. The fee rate is always explicit
The guard has already checked the confirmed plan, amount ≤ cap and one-time execution. rgb-lib prepares the PSBT that
commits to the transfer, and the consignment with the asset history.
Upload the consignment to the proxy
The asset history does not go on the blockchain: it goes through the RGB proxy. Privacy and scalability come from
Broadcast through Esplora. After a timeout there is no automatic retry: the wallet syncs and reads the transfer state.
The explorer shows a normal Bitcoin transaction (with the commitment hash), not "5 TUSDT". Confirmed in ~30 s.
From the proxy it takes the data it needs to verify the asset.
Asks Esplora whether the transaction with the commitment is confirmed.
Verifies the whole history back to issuance (NIA schema) and that the on-chain commitment matches, on its own. Nobody
Send the ack to the proxy
Accepts the transfer: the proxy records it.
The payer reads the ack: Settled
After a sync the transfer moves to Settled and the app shows the confirmation.
The payer reads the ack: Settled
After a sync the transfer moves to Settled and the app shows the confirmation.
